name: collaboration-ui
goal: People switch projects, follow project-scoped links and leave human comments in Electron and the hosted app; the hosted app never runs an agent

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Feature specs: packages/desktop/specification/features/planned/project-collaboration.md and packages/hub/specification/features/planned/hosted-workspace.md state routes, isolation, comment-never-agent, pending vs shared, hosted absence of agent controls.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Desktop: project-scoped routes and one link component, project switcher, store with selection queue and capabilities, Comment-first composer, comment and run stores, base panels, before/after helper. Hub: browser bridge, Google sign-in, projects, members, invitations, invite page, hosted workspace.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Desktop 16 new unit files and 2 browser specs with a two-local-one-shared bridge fixture; hub 8 unit files and 2 browser specs with an in-test API fixture. Existing ui-workspace, ui-designs, native-desktop specs unchanged.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Full root check exit0; desktop23/hub19 browser tests pass. Fresh synthetic previews inspected; live setup pending.

steps.title: Record failing frontend tests for project isolation, project routes, comments that never start an agent and absent hosted agent controls.
steps.evidence: Pre-implementation snapshot /tmp/harness-ui-red, final test files (sha256 in work/collaboration-ui/red.sha256). Desktop: playwright ui-projects ui-comments 8 failed; vitest test/stores test/utils 16 failed, 9 suites absent modules, 3 existing passed. Hub: playwright 11 failed (pages absent); vitest 7 suites absent modules. Logs work/collaboration-ui/red-*.log.

steps.title: Pass the same unchanged tests by sha256 after implementation; record commands and results.
steps.evidence: Same 28 files, sha256 identical (work/collaboration-ui/green.sha256 = red.sha256). Desktop on port 5799: playwright 19 passed incl. native Electron; vitest 125 passed. Hub on port 5798: playwright 11 passed; my 8 unit files 18 passed. Logs work/collaboration-ui/green-*.log.

steps.title: Capture and inspect fresh browser screenshots of the desktop renderer and the hosted app.
steps.evidence: Captured and inspected 19 PNGs in work/collaboration-ui/shots/out: desktop gate, catalog, entity comment/plan/historical, component, shared comment, before-after, tablet, mobile, native Electron design/history; hub sign-in, unconfigured, projects, members, invite, workspace, catalog, mobile. Fixture data, no live provider.

steps.title: Close the four integration gaps: native connection and approval page, cache status, history paging, named authors.
steps.evidence: Desktop on port 5799: playwright 23 passed (4 new in ui-hosted.spec.ts, native Electron included), vitest 142 passed, format, types, lint, build and audit pass. Hub on port 5798: playwright 14 passed (3 new in hosted-native.spec.ts), my 10 unit files pass, format, build and audit pass. Logs work/collaboration-ui/pass2-*.log.

steps.title: Hub sign-in confirms an address Google does not vouch for by a typed code, and signs nobody in before.
steps.evidence: Hub on port 5794 (5798 was taken): playwright 18 passed, 4 new in hosted-email.spec.ts; vitest 10 passed across browser-auth-email, session-email and the existing auth and session files; my files lint clean; format passes. Screenshot work/collaboration-ui/shots/out/hub-email-proof.png captured and inspected. In-test fixture only: no email sent, no provider. Log work/collaboration-ui/pass3-hub-e2e.log.
